about: Human corrections and categories for the answers ticked in audit-Sébastien.pdf. The PDF is left untouched: it keeps what the auditor ticked; this file says what was revised and why, and what each NON means. Written 2026-09-10 with the auditor.

corrections.why: the adaptation follows the citation in a table the page renders badly: « 68. 31998 D 0536: Décision 98/536/CE … À l'annexe, les entrées ci-après sont insérées entre les mentions relatives à la Belgique et au Danemark » followed by the laboratories of the ten new Member States. Found on the full text through the Cellar API, not visible on the EUR-Lex page.
corrections.lesson: a table can hide the relation sentence

corrections.why: the auditor compared a 1990 amendment with the 1972 original: the amounts differ (1 000 units of account in 1972, 2 590 ECU in 1990) because they were revised in between. The provision is the same: the value threshold for postal consignments in article 6, second subparagraph of the protocol, which the record of B contains.
corrections.lesson: comparing an amendment with the original text proves nothing; only the subject of the provision does

f-483026.reason: wrong target: A amends the conditions of the staff assigned in Belgium, B amended those of the staff assigned in Italy (two sites of the Joint Nuclear Research Centre)
f-483026.verified: titles only — the text of a 1970 Euratom regulation is not served by EUR-Lex or Cellar

f-488015.reason: granularity: the text repeals one article of B (« l'article 1er bis est abrogé »), B stays in force; the register records a repeal of the act
f-488015.verified: read by the auditor; B named in A, no repeal of the act

f-477411.reason: implicit by expiry and replacement: the scheme of 1101/89 « prend fin le 28 avril 1999 », A replaces it, B (2819/95, an amendment of 1101/89) is never named
f-477411.verified: number of B absent from the full text of A

f-185941.reason: implicit by competence: an own-initiative opinion under Article 307 TFEU, the article never cited
f-185941.verified: « article 307 » absent from the full text of A

f-477942.reason: implicit by accomplishment: B set the date of the opening of the common market for special steels, A records the opening; B is never named
f-477942.verified: read by the auditor — the text of a 1954 ECSC decision is not served by machine

f-488471.reason: implicit by cascade: A repeals 86/139 in so many words; B (86/150) amended 86/139 and appears only in a recital listing restrictions
f-488471.verified: « considérant que la décision 86/139/CEE peut être abrogée » found; no repeal of B

f-482247.reason: implicit by cascade: A is a recast repealing 800/1999; B set derogations to 800/1999 and is never named
f-482247.verified: number of B absent from the 221,567 characters of A

f-019135.reason: derogation, not amendment: « dérogeant au règlement (CEE) no 3007/84 »; no article of B is rewritten
f-019135.verified: found in the title of A

f-063404.reason: succession, not amendment: « les personnes … ont été nommées … par la décision d'exécution (UE) 2019/2168 » and the new ones succeed them; no article of B is rewritten
f-063404.verified: found in the text of A

category_meaning.registry_wrong: the register asserts something the act does not do: the truth is false on this fact
category_meaning.not_in_text: the relation is true in law but the act's text never states it: a graph built from the documents cannot find it, and must not be penalised for it
category_meaning.requalified: the text states a different relation (derogation, succession): an extractor reading the text produces another edge, correct in itself
